visual_description: A set of three tools: a flat stainless steel mini-crowbar and two heavy-duty nylon 'spudgers' (wedge-shaped sticks). They are designed to be wedged into the saw-cut line to lever the two halves of the plaster jacket apart without touching the fossil.

constraints.logic: The mechanic for the 'Grand Reveal'—the moment the top of the jacket is lifted.
constraints.background: Lying on a clean green cutting mat next to the TRX-07 pallet.
